spezado

Free accounting for everyone – from private finances to freelancers, companies and non-profits. spezado keeps the books of as many organisations as you like, runs on your own device – in the terminal, as a web app or on the command line – and keeps working offline. It is free software (AGPL-3.0-or-later), with every feature included and no telemetry.

This is the documentation of version 0.3, a preview: a freelancer’s year in the terminal and in the web app, in German and English. It is not yet for a real tax return – the German mappings (advance VAT return, Anlage EÜR, SKR 03/04) are drafts until tax advisers have reviewed them.

What 0.3 does

  • Books for a person: cash basis or double entry, standard VAT or small business, SKR 03 or SKR 04, opening balances; the state whose public holidays move deadlines and the permanent extension of VAT returns.
  • Bookings from a gross amount and a tax code or in lines; reversals instead of changes; journal, balances and ledgers.
  • Bank statements from camt.053, MT940 and CSV files, matched to bookings, invoices and earlier payments.
  • Documents and e-invoices: XRechnung and ZUGFeRD read into booking proposals, other files filed; every original kept by its hash.
  • Invoices written as XRechnung or ZUGFeRD – with VAT, exempt, under reverse charge, to other EU countries, as exports or as a small business.
  • Reports: the advance VAT returns with their deadlines, the Anlage EÜR, the HGB statements; closing periods and the GoBD data transfer.
  • A review list in words: whatever breaks a rule of accounting is shown, never fixed silently.
  • Synchronisation between a person’s own devices through a relay, end-to-end encrypted, with a recovery code – shared with other people who read or book, keys in the key store of the system (Synchronisation).
  • In the menu bar with spezado tray, started at login if wished (The web app); the desktop app installs and starts it by itself.
